proof.counterexample_without_zero_sign_suppres: control 0x8888 incorrectly gives 0x01010100; corrected algorithm gives zero
proof.argument: LUT bytes give unsigned magnitudes 0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12. A nibble-local OR marks nonzero low-three-bit magnitude. Only nonzero negative codes select sign replication. PRMT of 0x80 bytes yields 0x80 or 0xff; low-bit isolation and multiplication by 255 produce independent per-byte masks. Complement(m)+1 for m=1..12 lies in 244..255, so packed addition cannot carry across bytes. Positive and signed-zero bytes add zero.
